## Try It Out!
### Send admin email alerts for new Sharetribe users via Gmail

Automatically notify marketplace admins whenever a new user signs up. This workflow uses the Sharetribe Asset Get action to pull your marketplace's configured email template text, so your notification emails stay consistent with your brand.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for new user creation events.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text from Sharetribe's CDN.
* Gmail sends the admin a notification email with the new user's details and your marketplace email copy.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the Gmail node's "To" field with your admin email address.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account

### How to customize
* Change the email recipient to any address or distribution list.
* Modify the email subject and body to match your notification preferences.
* Use the Asset Get filter to pull specific email template fields.
* Replace Gmail with any other email node (Outlook, SMTP, etc.).

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new users
The Sharetribe Trigger polls your marketplace for `user/created` events. Each time a new user signs up, this node outputs the event data including the user's resource ID.

## 2. Get email template text
Retrieves your marketplace's email text content from Sharetribe's Asset Delivery API. This keeps your notification emails consistent with the copy configured in your Sharetribe Console.

## 3. Send admin notification
Sends an email to your admin address with details about the new user. Customize the subject line, body, and recipient as needed.
